description: This file defines the EmployeeAllowedSkillSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams to specify filtering parameters for employee skill searches within the OrangeHRM system. It includes a property for employee number and handles sorting by skill name.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedSkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A class extending FilterParams to encapsulate filtering criteria for employee allowed skills, including employee number and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Assigns the employee number to be used as a filter criterion.
